Cc: Mana Cho <m.cho@healthledger.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final week questions — rehearsal slots and checklist

Karthik / Ben —

Thanks for the runbook preview. We want to lock down two rehearsal windows next week (Nov 8 & Nov 9) before the production cutover on Nov 16. Can you confirm:

- Who is owning the client-facing comms (email + status page)?
- Final list of pre-cutover blockers we should expect (configuration, SSO, ingest throttling)?
- A single slide that summarizes rollback conditions for our execs.

Also attaching our internal compliance ask — it’s short.

Appreciate a quick reply with proposed times.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Platform Ops, HealthLedger
j.blake@healthledger.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <j.blake@healthledger.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final week questions — rehearsal slots and checklist

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear list. Below is our current plan and owners. We’ll circulate the formal slide deck by EOD tomorrow.

Summary of owners / action items (short):
- Client-facing comms (status + pre-cutover notice): Laura B. (I’ll review copy)
- Rehearsal orchestration & smoke test script: Ben C. (runbook v2 attached)
- SSO validation & auth smoke: Stephanie N. (test account matrix in drive)
- Ingest throttling / performance window: Karthik I. (observability hooks + fallback flags)
- Rollback decision authority: Laura + Jordan (see conditional triggers below)

Conditional rollback triggers (preliminary):
- >1% error rate sustained over 5m for critical write path
- KV cache mismatch affecting >0.5% active sessions
- Unrecoverable auth failures across >2 regions

Rehearsal slots proposed (all PST):
- Tue Nov 9 09:00–10:30 (primary)
- Wed Nov 10 16:00–17:30 (backup)

Attachments: redwood_ops_runbook_v2.pdf (contains smoke scripts + exact test queries)

Next steps: Ben to lead a 60m dry-run with HealthLedger QA and our SREs on Nov 9; Laura will publish the pre-cutover comms 48h before Nov 16 if the dry-run passes.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Office: +1 650-555-0124

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <j.blake@healthledger.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 14:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final week questions — rehearsal slots and checklist

Karthik / Jordan —

Confirmed: I’ll run the Nov 9 dry-run. Agenda for the 60m slot:
- 0–10m: kickoff, roles, success criteria
- 10–30m: simulated write-heavy traffic + KV-cache validation
- 30–45m: auth failover test (simulate token expiry + reauth)
- 45–55m: run rollback path to warm standby (non-destructive)
- 55–60m: debrief / immediate actions

I attached the runbook and a short checklist. Please upload your QA accounts to the shared sheet before Friday EOD.

Question for Jordan: given your compliance note, do we need to run any additional logging exports during rehearsal? We can enable extra retention for the window but want a clear scope to limit PII risk.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_ops_runbook_v2.pdf, cutover_communication_plan.xlsx

Jordan / Team —

Thanks for coordinating. Quick status and a couple of asks ahead of tomorrow’s dry-run:

Status snapshot:
- Comms draft: ready (I’ve flagged the contingency language for rollback)
- Exec slide (rollback + decision tree): ready and attached to the shared drive (link below)
- SSO test accounts: Stephanie has a partial list; Jordan, please add two service accounts to the QA sheet by EOD PST
- Observability hooks: Karthik has enabled additional token-level traces for rehearsal window

Open asks (action owners):
- Jordan: confirm if compliance needs the rehearsal log export (Ben asked). If yes, which retention window? (asked by 11/10 09:00)
- Stephanie: push the SSO matrix to the shared drive and mark known flaky accounts (asked by 11/10 12:00)
- Ben: bring the rollback checklist to the rehearsal and validate the non-destructive rollback run (asked by start of rehearsal)

If the dry-run passes with the checklist and no major errors, we’ll proceed to send the 48h pre-cutover comms on Nov 14. If any of the rollback triggers hit during the dry-run we will pause and triage with execs.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: exec_rollback_slide.pdf (uploaded to Drive)
